finding_dispositions.evidence: Reducer-owned review/pass/completion transitions are confined to registered semantic channels with current durable review or Completion Gate validation; direct injection is zero-write.
Same-content REVISE-to-PASS preserves the finding, writes no node.passed, and deterministically enters awaiting_human; changed-digest convergence passes.
The gate independently binds and executes stale-source, wrong-task, wrong-scope, event-type-mismatch, and one-use-reuse authority rejection tests.
